summary.name: whitechicks
summary.one_liner: whitechicks is an independent fan AI video tool at whitechicks.cc that turns 1–2 photos into a ~10–12s 9:16 night convertible "sing" meme clip.
use_cases: Making duo friend car meme videos
Making pet comedy Reels or Shorts
Generating AI meme clips for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
summary.what_it_does: whitechicks takes one or two uploaded photos and generates a short 9:16 vertical clip of a cream convertible at night. Duo mode uses two adult face photos (driver and passenger) for about 12 seconds; Pet mode uses one pet photo as the singing driver for about 10 seconds. No text prompt is needed: choose a mode, upload photos, and tap Create. The clip uses an original piano-pop audio bed rather than a known song. Pricing is pay-per-video, with a single 720p render at $8.88 (500 credits), and failed renders return credits.
notable: No-prompt flow: pick Duo or Pet, upload photos, Create
Original piano-pop audio only; no film footage or known-song audio
Pay-per-video credits with no subscription; failed renders restore credits
Output framed 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
caveats: Adults who agreed only: photos must be of adults who consented, or pets; no children, celebrities or strangers
Not affiliated with the Wayans brothers, the White Chicks film, or Vanessa Carlton
Render download links expire, so MP4 must be saved promptly; posts should be labeled AI-generated
